title: Reporting Receipt
description: Authenticated consumer evidence for one materialization. A receipt closes the knowledge gap between producer availability and consumer reconciliation. Buyer and governance consumers submit independently; neither consumer's receipt implies acceptance by another principal.

supersedes_reporting_receipt_id.description: Optional immutable rejected receipt replaced by this new receipt. It MUST name the caller's current rejected receipt for this obligation and revision; accepted current receipts are terminal.

consumer_commit_ref.description: Optional non-secret consumer checkpoint, transaction, or load identifier. It is evidence for operations, not authorization or a credential.

x-adcp-validation.authorization: The seller derives the consumer principal from authenticated transport and accepts receipts only for that principal's account-bound obligation and materialization. Unknown, unauthorized, cross-account, and cross-caller identifiers are indistinguishable.
x-adcp-validation.acceptance_match: accepted requires exact equality with the selected materialization verification evidence: row count and control totals always; canonical digest or manifest digest when selected. A mismatch MUST be submitted or recorded as rejected.
x-adcp-validation.immutability: A reporting_receipt_id is immutable. Exact retries are idempotent; reuse with different content is a conflict. A consumer retains one current leaf per obligation and revision: a new ID may supersede only that current rejected leaf. History remains append-only; an accepted current leaf is terminal.
